scope: Real Internet transport from PC to AWS, MQTT over SSH. Controlled interruption kills and restarts the owned SSH tunnel; not an ISP outage. Edge application withholding disabled. Nonblocking single-inflight publication and common dispatch cap. Synthetic telemetry, no physical sensors.
audit_checks: Every unique cloud receipt maps to the matching edge audit sample and timestamp. Publication completion is not proof of cloud commit.
clock_method: Envelope of before/after SSH time probes tightened by receipt causality; midpoint is descriptive, not certified one-way timing. A constant clock offset within each 20-second run is assumed.
